toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":4,"perceivedCorrectness":45,"actionability":6,"reason":"The breakdown by device and ISP points clearly at smart-TV 5.2, but the brief never explains why an app that is already live in every market stalls only in Kestria (a 5.2 × Tessaline interaction looks more likely), and its advice to \"hold the wider rollout\" conflicts with the digest saying 5.2 is already out everywhere, so I'm only partly convinced by its diagnosis even though the next steps are clear."}

output.reason: The breakdown by device and ISP points clearly at smart-TV 5.2, but the brief never explains why an app that is already live in every market stalls only in Kestria (a 5.2 × Tessaline interaction looks more likely), and its advice to "hold the wider rollout" conflicts with the digest saying 5.2 is already out everywhere, so I'm only partly convinced by its diagnosis even though the next steps are clear.
